description: Shows one of the user’s avatars ALIVE in the chat: animated, waving and saying a lip-synced welcome line (visual card in ChatGPT and Claude). Use when an avatar is ready or the user asks to see one of theirs. Free. In apps without cards, the reply carries the thumbnail and movements as text.

avatarId.description: Avatar id from meus_avatares or a finished job.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

name: show_my_avatar
title: Show my avatar
